text:
zoe: Heads-up: saw a spike in resume attempts after we rolled out the 'routing.priority_shift' flag from console. Multiple sessions got re-routed mid-resume and retried, causing duplicate billing signals.

chris: Can you paste a tiny log snippet?

zoe: Sure:
```
2026-05-04T02:11:02Z INFO resume_attempt session=s-118 token=t-9 route=eu-n1
2026-05-04T02:11:03Z INFO route_change session=s-118 from=eu-n1 to=eu-fast reason=priority_shift
2026-05-04T02:11:03Z INFO resume_attempt session=s-118 token=t-9 route=eu-fast
```

indra: Looks like console changed routing preference immediately after auth. Runtime didn't ack before the second resume. Billing pipeline treats resume_attempt as billable.

chris: Two quick mitigations: 1) rollback the console flag for canary cohort, 2) add a short server-side debounce to ignore identical session+token resumes within 1500ms.

lyn: Telemetry note: our metrics lost the `route` tag during the rollout due to an older metrics-shim not passing through new labels. Hard to slice by cohort. I'll hotpatch the shim to keep tags.

pagerduty-bot: Alert rule created: resume_attempts_per_session > 4 in 1m -> page eng-oncall.

indra: Also filing BILL-201: gate billing on resume_ack from runtime rather than resume_attempt edge event. That should prevent charging until runtime confirms.

zoe: I'll flip the rollout to rollback if the debounce patch doesn't land in 10m. Can someone own the debounce PR?

chris: I'll push debounce PR and a small unit test for dedupe. Deploying to staging in 5m.

lyn: After shim fix, I'll add a dashboard panel showing resume_ack latency per-route so future rollouts show immediate signal.

indra: Postmortem actions: console rollout checklist needs a route-stability guard, metrics tag validation pre-rollout, and billing guard.

zoe: Thanks everyone. Prioritize debounce + shim patch.
